text: おれは　まけるのが　だい　きらい　なんだ！

structure.jp: だい　きらい　なんだ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. まけるの = 'losing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.span: だい　きらい　なんだ
patterns.explanation: なんだ at the end adds an explaining, emphatic tone, like 'the thing is'. だい　きらい　なんだ = 'the thing is, I hate it'.
